Implement Inventory Service with SQLite, Service Layer, and FastAPI
tasks.description:
Implement a complete inventory service with:
1. Database layer (src/inventory/database.py) - SQLite with products and stock_movements tables
2. Service layer (src/inventory/service.py) - Business logic for CRUD and stock operations
3. Models (src/inventory/models.py) - Product and StockMovement dataclasses
4. FastAPI REST API (src/inventory/api.py) - Endpoints for products and stock

All code must pass the acceptance tests in tests/test_inventory.py. Do not modify the test file. The acceptance tests cover:
- Product CRUD (create, get by id/sku, list)
- Stock operations (receive, ship, adjust with validation)
- Stock history tracking
- Price conversion and timestamps

Use the existing file structure in src/inventory/ as starting point.
